Done. The script at `out/T1/solution.py` ran once and succeeded, writing `out/T1/model.safetensors` with 86 tensors and contiguous blocks 0..11.

What the script does:
- Reads both shards via the index file's weight map and loads all 114 tensors.
- Drops blocks 2, 6, 10, 14 and renumbers survivors into a fresh dict, so renames cannot overwrite each other. A destination-key collision check guards this anyway.
- Enforces the required checks before writing: no block index 12 or higher, exactly 12 q_proj tensors, block indices exactly 0..11, exactly 86 tensors. It also spot-checks that renamed and non-block tensors are bit-identical to the source.
- Re-opens the written file and deletes it if the tensor count is wrong.

The self-report is at `out/T1/REPORT.md`. It records one execution, no failures.
